==About==

A {{i|Boiled Waning Toadstool}} is made by boiling a {{i|Waning Toadstool}} in a {{i|Clay Pot}}, {{i|Copper Pot}}, or {{i|Cauldron}}. With the [[Fungiculture]] skill learned, a Boiled Waning Toadstool can still be planted in a {{i|Gardening Pot}} to grow a Waning Toadstool. When planting a Boiled Waning Toadstool there is a chance for it to grow into a {{i|Spooky Redcap}} instead. Planting Mushrooms in Gardening Pots lowers [[Insanity]]. A Boiled Waning Toadstool can be stored in a {{i|MushiSack}}. '''CAUTION:''' There is a high chance that even after boiling, a Waning Toadstool will still be poisonous. A Boiled Waning Toadstool, Boiled Waxing Toadstool, Waning Toadstool, and a {{i|Waxing Toadstool}} all count as a Waxing Toadstool when planting and in Food recipes.
